# Pin how CountryFlags turns a location into a flag

## Welcome 👋

The DevIndex grid shows a round flag next to each developer's location, from free text like "Berlin, Germany" or "San Francisco, USA". `Neo.util.CountryFlags` turns that text into an ISO country code and a flag URL. It has five matching steps, a few surprising edges, and no test yet.

This is a **good first issue** for Hacktoberfest 2026. It needs Node.js and a clone of this repository: no Docker, no AI setup.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Reserved for first-time Neo.mjs contributors.** The maintainer team will not claim, edit, or implement this issue through **2026-10-31**. Comment here to claim it, and ask anything on this issue.

**Set up once:** follow [Set up the engine from a clone](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up-the-engine-from-a-clone), including `npm run bundle-browser-deps`: without it the unit suite selects zero tests.

## Where things live

- Source: `src/util/CountryFlags.mjs`: the static methods `getCountryCode(input)` and `getFlagUrl(nameOrCode)`, the `aliasMap`, and 243 `countries`
- New test file: `test/playwright/unit/util/CountryFlags.spec.mjs`
- Pattern to copy: `test/playwright/unit/util/Array.spec.mjs` (the `setup()` call and imports)
- Tip: these are static methods, so there is no instance to create and nothing to mock. `getFlagUrl` only builds a URL; nothing is fetched.

## What to cover

| Call | Expected |
|---|---|
| `getCountryCode('Germany')`, `('germany')`, `('  GERMANY ')` | `'de'`: trimmed, and any case |
| `getCountryCode('DE')` | `'de'` |
| `getCountryCode('USA')`, `('UK')` | `'us'`, `'gb'`: an alias wins before the two-letter rule |
| `getCountryCode('zz')` | `'zz'`: any two letters count as a code |
| `getCountryCode('x1')` | `'x1'` |
| `getCountryCode('Berlin, Germany')` | `'de'`: a country name inside longer text |
| `getCountryCode('San Francisco, USA')` | `'us'`: an alias inside longer text |
| `getCountryCode('Somalia')` / `('Mali')` | `'so'` / `'ml'`: whole words only |
| `getCountryCode('Dominican Republic')` / `('Dominica')` | `'do'` / `'dm'`: the longer name wins |
| `getCountryCode('Remote')`, `('Deutschland')`, `('')`, `(null)`, `(42)` | `null` |
| `getFlagUrl('Germany')` | `'https://hatscripts.github.io/circle-flags/flags/de.svg'` |
| `getFlagUrl('zz')` | `'https://hatscripts.github.io/circle-flags/flags/zz.svg'`, a URL for a code that does not exist |
| `getFlagUrl('x1')` | `null`: the URL needs two letters |
| `getCountryCode('England')` / `getFlagUrl('England')` | `'gb-eng'` / `null`. The alias maps to a region code that the two-letter check refuses. Pin it as it is, and if you think England should get a flag, say so on this issue. |

## Done when

- [ ] `test/playwright/unit/util/CountryFlags.spec.mjs` exists, following the pattern file's setup.
- [ ] One `test(...)` per table row.
- [ ] Test-only: if the class disagrees with a row, say so on this issue before changing `src/`.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/util/CountryFlags.spec.mjs` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit` passes.

## Out of scope

The `CountryFlag` component and the country field that use this class, and completing the country list.

## While you wait for review

You just pinned one small piece of a multi-threaded application engine: in Neo.mjs your app's code runs inside a web worker, and the main thread only paints. Two things worth ten minutes:

- **See the part nobody expects.** Run `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all` and `npm run server-start`, open `apps/workstation/`, and drag a tab out of the browser window. It becomes its own OS window, still running, with the same component instances and the same worker. [Benefits: Introduction](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/benefits/Introduction.md) explains why that is possible.
- **Your coding agent can go much further here.** The skills this repository's AI maintainers work with are published on npm as [`neo-agent-skills`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/neo-agent-skills), and they need no Knowledge Base and no Memory Core. With Claude or GPT beside you, the `help wanted` issues are within reach after this one.
